verses.1: For Jehovah your God will surely destroy those nations whom Jehovah your God gives you as inheritance. You will take their land and settle in their cities and among their families.
verses.2: Six cities will be distinguished for you within your land. These cities will be given to you by Jehovah, your God, so that you may possess them.
verses.3: You shall prepare the way for yourself, and you shall set up the boundaries of your land. This land will be given to you by Jehovah your God. It shall become a place of peace for all who desire it.
verses.4: And this is the words of the murderer who has killed and lived. He will kill his neighbor without any knowledge of it. And he doesn’t even want to be punished for his actions.
verses.5: And when he brought his friend into the forest, where there were many trees. He tried to cut down those trees with an axe. But the metal tool broke apart from the tree. Then he found his friend dead. He rushed back to one of these villages and lived on.
verses.6: For the murderer will not stop killing after he has killed. His heart will burn with rage, and he will continue to kill until his life is ended. There will be no justice for him, because he doesn’t want to be punished at all.
verses.7: Therefore, I command you to say that three cities must be distinguished for you.
verses.8: And if Jehovah your God expands your territory, as it was promised to your ancestors, and gives you all the land that He spoke about giving to your ancestors…
verses.9: For you shall keep all these commandments that I command you today: to love the LORD your God, and to walk in His ways every day. And you shall also build three more cities on those three sites.
verses.10: And do not shed innocent blood in the midst of your land, since Jehovah your God has given you this land as a inheritance. Otherwise, there will be bloodshed upon you.
verses.11: And if there is someone who hates his neighbor, and he harms him, then that person will be killed. He will die, and his soul will be lost. Then he will go to one of the other cities.
verses.12: And they sent out the old men of the city, and they took him there. Then they handed him over to the executioner’s hands, and he died.
verses.13: Do not look upon him with hatred in your eyes. It is better for you to live in peace, free from the bloodshed that has taken place in Israel.
verses.14: Do not cross the boundaries of your neighbors, who have set those boundaries in your land. This land will be given to you by Jehovah, your God, so that you may possess it.
verses.15: No witness will be needed for any sin or transgression that is committed by two witnesses or three witnesses.
verses.16: For a witness will rise up against him, to condemn him.
verses.17: And there stood the two men who had a dispute before Jehovah, before the priests and judges who would be present in those days.
verses.18: And the judges judged fairly. But behold, there was a false witness who gave a false testimony against his brother.
verses.19: And you did what was right to do for his brother, but in the midst of your evil intentions.
verses.20: And those who remain will listen and take notice, but they will not be motivated to do anything else regarding this bad thing that has happened to you.
verses.21: And do not compare your eyes to a human soul; do not compare one eye to another eye; do not compare a tooth to another tooth; do not compare a hand to another hand; and do not compare a foot to another foot.
